I5.quote: We demonstrate in-situ synthesis of homogeneously dispersed Ni-containing mesoporous carbon scaffold (Ni-MCS) for improving dehydrogenation kinetics of LiAlH4 (hereafter denoted as LAH).

notes: The paper studies dehydrogenation of LiAlH4 (LAH) confined in mesoporous carbon scaffolds (MCS, Ni-MCS). The Sieverts apparatus is used only for desorption: 'Hydrogen storage properties of the nano-composite materials were examined by an automated Sieverts' apparatus (Suzuki Shokan PCT H2 Absorption Rig)' (main, p. 4, Characterization and properties evaluation), and the results are desorption amounts: 'LAH-confined-Ni-MCS system at 225 C releases a total of 6.19 wt% hydrogen in 120 min' (main, p. 8, Dehydrogenation kinetics section); Figs. 8 and 9 (main, p. 6) plot 'H2 desorbed (wt%)'. No gas-phase H2 uptake (absorption or adsorption) is reported for any sample, and no rehydrogenation data are given. The H2 is released by a complex hydride, not taken up by a carbon sorbent.
